notes.title: Updates notes for Patch 3
notes.notes:
A new update is ready for release! We have several bug fixes and improvements as part of this release, as well as new props to decorate your worlds!



Fixes:

Presets with decorations could sometimes not be placed

Shadows would inconsistently pop in and out at different distances

Fixed a bug that would incorrectly mark dirty settings changes when going to the video tab

Campfire would not play a fire VFX, regardless if you turn it on or off

Fixed VSync not turning off when turning fullscreen off

Autosave game names would stack _Autosave sometimes

Fixed a crash that sometimes occurred after leaving a creative world

Fix issue where the savegame throbber would sometimes incorrectly show up

Fixed a randomly occurring GPU crash

Fix some tutorial widgets preventing clicking into the game

Fix the tutorial widget sometimes overlaying the game when it shouldn't



Features:

Wind turbines now have color variations

New backpack decoration

New bedroll decoration

New fire pot decoration

New field bed decoration

New hollow trunk decoration

New cardboard boxes decoration

New bench variation

New branch decoration

FPS limit setting (30, 60, 75, 90, 120, 144, unlimited)

notes.title: Update notes for Patch 2
notes.notes:
We have further performance improvements ready for you.

After a thorough process of improving the process of Evershire we are happy to announce we've achieved up to 30% performance improvements on larger levels.

We've made progress on improvements on both the CPU and GPU and are continuously working on improving the performance further.

Changes:
Visual changes to the wind turbine have been made in preparation for more customization options on the wind turbine.

notes.title: Update notes for Patch 1
notes.notes:
We have a few fixes ready for all of you, below is a list of what was changed in this version.

Fixes:
* 40-Tiles Lake achievement can now be achieved
* Building placement achievements now work again
* Score achievements now work again
* Decorations can be rotated during modification
* Details of decorations now properly follow the structure when being moved
* Details of decorations no longer stay blue after failing to move a decoration
* Details of the windmill now don't randomize every time the underlying tile changes
* Decoration modify rotation is now smoothed
* Fixed tutorial widgets overlaying the structure placement popup
* Fixed tutorial widgets not being centered in the screen on widescreens
* Fixed card rewards overlaying the tutorial widgets
* Fixed tutorial widgets being visible during preset creation
* Fixed typos in the German localization

Improvements:
We have performed a large optimization pass to ensure that framerate remains stable when many buildings and decorations with rotating/moving elements are placed.

Changes:
Animal movement (except hopping in place) is currently disabled due to the severe performance impact the moving animals have on the CPU. We are working on a solution to this and will push an update in the future where animal movement is re-enabled when the performance aspect is taken care of.

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Evershire is releasing on December 12th in Early Access! 

After a long time developing Evershire, we have decided to release in Early Access. Our initial goal was to release as a full title, however we soon realized that we have many features that we'd like to include in Evershire that would not make it into the initial release. 

Early access will allow us to listen to community feedback as we develop Evershire, to further improve gameplay and user experience, while developing additional features. Should you play Evershire in Early Access, we would be very happy to hear of any feedback you have about the gameplay, its balancing and your experience, negative or positive. 

We'll be monitoring the Steam forums, reviews, as well as our Discord and our social media pages, so if you have a question or feedback, just let us know! :)

Thank you everyone who has wishlisted Evershire so far, and we're happy to see so much positive feedback on our social media.

Gerald is patiently waiting for you in his natural habitat.
